criteria.requirement: Implement marshmallow.unique.UniqueList(inner,*,key=None,**kwargs) as a true List field. Run normal inner deserialization first, then uniqueness on resulting values or a callable projection. Support unhashable keys without stringification; bool differs from numeric values. Report every later duplicate at its input index with first-occurrence context, preserve valid_data and native inner errors/required/allow_none. Keep standard serialization. Repeated schema instances must not share bound inner fields or per-call observations.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
